query: What line-item budget and cost estimates are needed (staff time, travel, honoraria, digitization, hosting, software, legal counsel, contingency) to justify funding and resource allocation?

response.query: What line-item budget and cost estimates are needed (staff time, travel, honoraria, digitization, hosting, software, legal counsel, contingency) to justify funding and resource allocation?
response.answer: For funding and resource allocation, include staff time, travel, honoraria, digitization, hosting, software, legal counsel, and contingency costs. Budget estimates must cover all these line items precisely.
